g.text: UC.23 - Internal Document Upload & Approval Workflow
1. Open Document Upload & select owning department
3. Validate file extension and file size (<= 50 MB)
4. Compute SHA-256 cryptographic hash of file content
Query PostgreSQL documents table by sha256_hash
5. Save file to staging storage & insert record
6. Send approval notification to Knowledge Administrator
10a. Write Audit Log & notify uploader (not ingested)
11b. Update status = INDEXED_READY & write Audit Log
7. Open Document Approval Queue & preview document
